propositions: When a ticket is re-reviewed after a BLOCK verdict with recorded blocking findings, a deterministic pre-check must warn if all cited evidence anchors from the blocking findings remain verbatim unchanged in the current plan material.
The pre-check warning is warn-only (logger.warning, no hard block, no exit-code change) to preserve the ~8% verdict-flap recovery cases where BLOCK→PASS occurs with no material change.

The warning fires only when the plan's description component fingerprint is identical to the sidecar-recorded fingerprint AND at least one cited anchor matches verbatim; unmatchable or paraphrased anchors never trigger the warning alone.
The precheck.cited_anchor_warning metric (true/false) is recorded in every review's sidecar to enable offline measurement of warning hit rate and predictive value per ADR 0054.

The pre-check runs after verdict_reuse (zero-cost reuse for wholly unchanged plans) but before drift_refresh and billable LLM calls, filling the gap where plan prose is untouched but review code or file impact changed.
The implementation is isolated in a new module cited_anchor.py with a 4-line wiring hook in _run_plan_review to stay within module-size gates (793/800 LOC).
